class.name: SteamDiagnostics
class.brief_description: Captures Steam SDK diagnostic severities for a client scope.
class.description: Get this service from [method SteamClient.diagnostics]. Start capture and drain snapshots from the main thread. One client scope can own the process-wide SDK warning hook at a time. The client releases capture automatically when it stops or exits the scene tree.

method.name: drain
method.description: Takes the current messages in capture order and resets the queue and overflow count. Returns an empty snapshot for an inactive scope, a caller without ownership, or a call from outside the main thread.

method.name: start
method.description: Claims the process-wide warning hook. Returns [constant OK] for a new capture or if this service already owns it. Returns [constant ERR_BUSY] when another scope owns it or a caller invokes this method outside the main thread. Returns [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] when the scope or SDK hook is unavailable.

method.name: stop
method.description: Releases this service's hook and discards pending diagnostics on the main thread. Repeated calls and calls by other scopes leave the hook state as it is.
